title: How does TLS 1.3 reach encryption in one round trip?

glossary.note: Encrypts the connection and proves the server's identity.
Two one-time key pairs make one shared secret.
Turns a shared secret into keys.

key_points: The key share rides in ClientHello, so one round trip is enough.
After ServerHello the certificate and Finished are encrypted.
Early data can be replayed, so only safe-to-repeat requests should use it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You press Enter on an https address. Before one page byte moves, two computers must agree on a secret, in public.
beats.say: You press Enter on an H T T P S address. Before one page byte moves, two computers must agree on a secret, in public.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: How do you agree on a secret in public?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Each side makes a one-time key pair. The ClientHello carries the browser's public half, an X25519 key share, guessing which group the server accepts.
beats.say: Each side makes a one-time key pair. The Client Hello carries the browser's public half, an X two five five one nine key share, guessing which group the server accepts.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: ServerHello carries its public half. Now both run ECDHE, mix the result with HKDF, and hold the same handshake secrets. Nobody sent a secret.
beats.say: Server Hello carries its public half. Now both run E C D H E, mix the result with H K D F, and hold the same handshake secrets. Nobody sent a secret.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: So the certificate still travels in the clear?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: No. Everything after ServerHello is encrypted: EncryptedExtensions, Certificate, CertificateVerify, Finished.
beats.say: No. Everything after Server Hello is encrypted: Encrypted Extensions, Certificate, Certificate Verify, Finished.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: It verifies the certificate chain, the signature and the Finished check, then sends its own Finished and the request.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: How many round trips was that?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.say: One. T L S one point two needed two.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: With a pre-shared key from an earlier visit, early data rides in the first flight. It can be replayed, so use it only for requests that are safe to repeat.
